doc.intent: Do not sharpen away the hardware VI softness.
doc.orientation: The RetroArch frame_output contract requires an upright bottom-left-origin game frame in GL space; the N64 acceptance test composes this system binding with that platform contract.
doc.shader: Mupen renders high-res; the compositor applies the declared soft 240p preset when shaders are enabled.
doc.extensions: Only what Mupen64Plus-Next declares it opens plus the archives RetroArch unpacks. A 64DD .ndd or .d64 is no game on its own (the core finds a .ndd beside the ROM), so both were dropped; neither occurs in the library.
